description: This Java source file defines the SubscriptionNotFoundException class, a custom exception used in the context of the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate that a subscription with a specific ID was not found. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, and contains an inner builder class.

classes.name: SubscriptionNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating a subscription was not found, extends DittoRuntimeException and implements ThingSearchException.

classes.name: SubscriptionNotFoundException.Builder
classes.description: A mutable builder class for constructing SubscriptionNotFoundException instances with a fluent API.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a SubscriptionNotFoundException with a message indicating the subscription ID that was not found.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a SubscriptionNotFoundException from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: getEmptyBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder instance for this exception.
